timeline.title: M&M Financial reports Q2 today
timeline.line: Business update showed Q2 disbursements up 22% to ~₹16,490 cr; assets up ~15%.
more: Collection efficiency estimated at 97% vs 96% a year ago
Stage-3 assets estimated at 3.35–3.45% vs 3.94% a year ago
Q1 FY27 net profit was ₹927 cr
